name: markdown-file-tree
description: Renders filetree code blocks as file trees in VSCode's markdown preview, like the explorer: Seti icons, git status colors and folders that open and close, in the editor's theme
author: Drake Costa <drake@saeris.io> (https://saeris.gg)

bumpy.buildCommand: vp pack && vp exec postcss src/file-tree.css --output dist/file-tree.css && vp exec vsce package --no-dependencies
